newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone launches IDD service.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone launches IDD service.

text.p: SmarTone Mobile Communications Ltd said on Tuesday it has launched an IDD service which offers customers savings of up to 57 percent on international calls compared to its previous rates.
Ritchie Ma, senior marketing manager at SmarTone, said SmarTone previously offered IDD rates based on Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd's IDD rate less five percent.
"We are offering an alternative route for customers to use, instead of using the Hongkong Telecom IDD," he said.
Ma said the "SmartIDD" tariff for calls to the United States was HK$2.80 per minute compared to a previous rate of HK$6.46.
SmartIDD calls to the United Kingdom would cost HK$4.90 per minute compared to a previous rate of HK$8.36.
